newItems.definition: The busy noise and activity of a place.

mainWord.definition: Relating to a city or town.

lessons.mainWordForms: Urban is an adjective. Relating to a city or town. Urban life is busy and exciting.

context: Daniel talks to Maya about city life at work.
We live in the heart of the city. The skyline is full of tall towers.
dialogue: Daniel: Maya, what is urban life like?
Maya: Urban life is fast. A metropolis never sleeps.
Daniel: What is a metropolis?
Maya: A metropolis is a very large and busy city.
Daniel: And the skyline?
Maya: The skyline is the shape of the buildings. We live in the heart of the city, and I love the hustle and bustle.
lessons.listening: On Monday, Daniel talks to Maya about city life at work. He asks, 'Maya, what is urban life like?' Maya says, 'Urban life is fast. A metropolis never sleeps.' Daniel asks, 'What is a metropolis?' Maya says, 'A metropolis is a very large and busy city.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Maya.' Daniel smiles.
lessons.question: What does Daniel ask about?
lessons.reading: On Monday, Daniel talks to Maya about city life at work at Carter Retail Group. He asks, 'Maya, what is urban life like?' Maya says, 'Urban life is fast and full of change. A metropolis is a very large and busy city, and it never sleeps. People come here from many towns to work, to study, and to find work.' Daniel asks, 'What is a skyline?' Maya says, 'The skyline is the shape of a city's buildings against the sky. We live in the heart of the city, so we see tall towers every day. I love the hustle and bustle of the streets, the shops, and the markets.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Maya. I want to live in the heart of the city too.' Maya says, 'Good. Urban life is busy, but it is full of chances to learn and grow.'
lessons.readingQ: What does Maya say about city life?
lessons.readingA: Urban life is fast, and a metropolis never sleeps.
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about city life. What is it like? What do you love about it?
lessons.speakingSample: I want to tell you about city life. On Monday, Daniel talked about city life at work. He said, 'Urban life is fast and full of change.' A metropolis is a very large and busy city, and it never sleeps. The skyline is the shape of a city's buildings against the sky. We live in the heart of the city, and I love the hustle and bustle of the streets.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about city life. Say what you love about it.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about city life. On Monday, Daniel talked about city life at work. He said, 'Urban life is fast and full of change.' A metropolis is a very large and busy city, and it never sleeps. The skyline is the shape of a city's buildings against the sky. We live in the heart of the city, and I love the hustle and bustle of the streets. I hope you will visit us one day. Please tell me about your town. Best, Daniel
lessons.sound: Urban has its strongest beat on UR. In urban, say UR clearly at the start. In metropolis, say TROP clearly in the middle.

newItems.definition: A very tall building in a city.
newItems.example: The city has a new skyscraper.

newItems.definition: With people and food from many countries.
newItems.example: Our city is lively and cosmopolitan.

newItems.definition: A home where you feel safe and happy.
newItems.example: A place to call home is important.

newItems.definition: To start living in the same home.
newItems.example: They move in together.

newItems.definition: To start a calm, permanent life in a new place.
newItems.example: We settle down in a new town.
newItems.word: settle down in a new town

mainWord.definition: A very tall building in a city.

lessons.mainWordForms: Skyscraper is a noun. A very tall building in a city. The city has a new skyscraper.
lessons.expression: A place to call home is important.
lessons.use: Use this when you talk about a new home in a city.
lessons.expressionTask: Daniel meets Sara at a park. What does he ask her?
lessons.grammar: Wish and if only for review: I wish I had bought a flat near the park
lessons.pattern: I wish I had bought a flat near the park.
lessons.task: I wish I had ___ a flat near the park.
lessons.example: I wish I had bought a flat near the park.
context: Daniel meets Sara at a park and talks about the city.
A place to call home is important. We move in together soon.
dialogue: Daniel: Sara, do you know what a skyscraper is?
Sara: Yes. A skyscraper is a very tall building in a city.
Daniel: What is cosmopolitan?
Sara: Cosmopolitan means a place has people and food from many countries.
Daniel: What is a place to call home?
Sara: A place to call home is a home where you feel safe. We move in together soon, and we settle down in a new town.
lessons.listening: On Monday, Daniel meets Sara at a park. He asks, 'Sara, do you know what a skyscraper is?' Sara says, 'Yes. A skyscraper is a very tall building in a city.' Daniel asks, 'What is cosmopolitan?' Sara says, 'Cosmopolitan means a place has people and food from many countries.' Daniel is happy. He says, 'Thank you, Sara.'
lessons.question: What is a skyscraper?
lessons.reading: On Monday, Daniel meets Sara at a park and talks about the city. He asks, 'Sara, do you know what a skyscraper is?' Sara says, 'Yes. A skyscraper is a very tall building in a city. Our city is lively and cosmopolitan, with people and food from many countries.' Daniel asks, 'What is a place to call home?' Sara says, 'For me, a place to call home is a home where you feel safe. A place to call home is important.' Daniel says, 'I wish I had bought a flat near the park. We move in together soon, and we settle down in a new town.' Daniel smiles. He says, 'Good. Our new town will be our home.' Sara is happy. She says, 'Thank you, Daniel. We will move in together, and we will settle down in a new town.'
lessons.readingQ: What does Sara say about the city?
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about the city. What is a skyscraper? What does cosmopolitan mean?
lessons.speakingSample: I want to tell you about the city. On Monday, Daniel talked to Sara at a park. He said, 'Sara, do you know what a skyscraper is?' Sara said, 'Yes. A skyscraper is a very tall building in a city.' Our city is lively and cosmopolitan. A place to call home is a safe home. We move in together soon, and we settle down in a new town.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about the city. Say what you will do.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Tom, I want to tell you about the city. On Monday, Daniel talked to Sara at a park. He said, 'Sara, do you know what a skyscraper is?' Sara said, 'Yes. A skyscraper is a very tall building in a city.' Our city is lively and cosmopolitan, with people and food from many countries. A place to call home is a home where you feel safe. We move in together soon, and we settle down in a new town. Please tell me about your week. Best, Daniel
lessons.sound: Skyscraper has its strongest beat on SKY. In skyscraper, say SKY clearly at the start. In cosmopolitan, say POL clearly in the middle.
lessons.model: The city has a new skyscraper.
